repos_data.description: Don't write a bug report — record it. Local MCP: screen recording → transcript, frames, OCR, wall-clock evidence for coding agents.
Official MCP server for Scribefy — search YouTube and extract clean, timestamped transcripts in Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client.

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for video analysis — extracts transcripts, key frames, OCR text, and metadata from video URLs. Supports Loom and direct video files.
